title: Constant etale sheaves on a curve
statement: Let $C$ be a curve [def-sc-curves] and let $n\geq1$. The *constant etale sheaf* $\mathbf F_n$ on the small etale site $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] with value $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$: the sheafification of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$. Its geometric stalks are $\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$ by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk].

split_report.summary: The constant sheaf with value Z/nZ is the specialization of the general constant-sheaf construction in def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf and Mathlib's CategoryTheory.constantSheaf. The imported geometric-stalk clause remains in the statement and cites the already split lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk, which proves it for any abelian group. No new node is needed. The read-only slopmaster2 source has Etale.constantModSheaf (SmoothBaseChange/Defs.lean:94), but it is formulated over an arbitrary coefficient ring and does not itself state the geometric-stalk assertion.
